metadata.title: Mithril Sync in Rust Watchdog Tasks
metadata.description: Move the entire Mithril snapshot sync lifecycle from TypeScript into the Rust watchdog binary
metadata.importantNote: Resolve the open questions in the PRD (snapshot-converter path, converter progress format) before starting Phase 1.

phases.name: Rust Mithril State Machine
phases.description: Implement the full Mithril lifecycle in Rust: config, behind-ness probe, download, staging, marker file, converter, node/wallet start

tasks.title: Add MithrilConfig to WatchdogConfig
tasks.description: Add an optional `mithril: Option<MithrilConfig>` field to the top-level WatchdogConfig struct. MithrilConfig holds: mithril_bin (PathBuf), aggregator_url (String), genesis_vkey (String), ancillary_vkey (Option<String>), behind_threshold (u64, default 20).
implementationNotes: Add `MithrilConfig` struct with serde Deserialize, derive Debug and Clone.
Add `#[serde(default)] mithril: Option<MithrilConfig>` to WatchdogConfig.
Add `fn default_behind_threshold() -> u64 { 20 }` and annotate field.

tasks.title: Add Mithril event variants to protocol.rs
tasks.description: Add MithrilStatus, MithrilProgress, MithrilNotNeeded, MithrilError variants to the Event enum in protocol.rs. These are emitted by the watchdog stdout and parsed by CardanoWatchdog.ts.
implementationNotes: MithrilStatus { phase: String }
MithrilProgress { files_downloaded: u64, files_total: u64, bytes_downloaded: u64, bytes_total: u64, seconds_elapsed: f64, step_num: u32, total_steps: u32 }
MithrilNotNeeded { local_immutable_count: u64, latest_certified_immutable: u64 }
MithrilError { code: String, message: String }
Use #[serde(tag = "event", rename_all = "snake_case")] consistent with existing variants.

tasks.title: Write watchdog/src/mithril.rs — behind-ness probe
tasks.description: Implement the behind-ness probe: spawn mithril-client with `cardano-db snapshot show latest --json`, parse beacon.immutable_file_number, count local immutable files in <chainPath>/immutable/, compare against threshold.
implementationNotes: Use `tokio::process::Command` to spawn mithril-client.
Set AGGREGATOR_ENDPOINT env var from config.aggregator_url.
Parse stdout as JSON: `beacon.immutable_file_number` field.
Count files in chain_path/immutable/ with extension `.chunk` (or count all files, matching TS behavior).
Return `BehindnessResult::NotNeeded { local, certified }` or `BehindnessResult::Needed { local, certified }`.
If NotNeeded, emit MithrilNotNeeded event and return.

tasks.title: Write mithril.rs — download phase with progress streaming
tasks.description: Spawn mithril-client cardano-db download with correct args and env vars. Stream stdout JSON lines, parse progress objects, emit MithrilProgress events rate-limited to 500 ms. Emit MithrilStatus phase changes.
implementationNotes: CLI: `mithril-client --origin-tag DAEDALUS --json cardano-db download latest --download-dir <staging> --include-ancillary`
Env: AGGREGATOR_ENDPOINT, GENESIS_VERIFICATION_KEY, ANCILLARY_VERIFICATION_KEY (if present).
Parse JSON lines from stdout: fields files_downloaded, files_total, bytes_downloaded, bytes_total, seconds_elapsed, step_num, total_steps.
Rate-limit MithrilProgress emissions: track last_emitted_at (Instant), skip if < 500 ms since last.
Always emit the final progress line when mithril-client exits.
Emit MithrilStatus { phase: 'downloading' } before spawn, 'verifying' when step_num crosses the verifying threshold.
On non-zero exit code, emit MithrilError and return Err.

tasks.title: Write mithril.rs — staging directory management
tasks.description: Create staging directory before download, validate after download (check for clean, immutable/, ledger/, protocolMagicId files), clean up on error.
implementationNotes: Staging path: parent of chain_path / 'mithril-partial-sync' / 'download' / 'db'
Create staging dir with tokio::fs::create_dir_all.
Post-download validation: check `clean` file exists, `immutable/` dir exists, `ledger/` dir exists, `protocolMagicId` file exists.
On validation failure: emit MithrilError, clean staging dir, return Err.
Expose cleanup fn called on cancellation too.

tasks.title: Write mithril.rs — marker file management
tasks.description: Read existing marker file on startup (resume logic). Write cutover-in-progress before rename, installed-awaiting-node-start after rename, node-start-verified after wallet_ready.
implementationNotes: Marker path: state_dir / 'Logs' / 'mithril-partial-sync.lock'
JSON format: { "state": "cutover-in-progress" | "installed-awaiting-node-start" | "node-start-verified" }
On watchdog startup (before start_mithril command), read marker: if installed-awaiting-node-start, skip to node/wallet start; if cutover-in-progress, clean staging and set phase to idle.
Write cutover-in-progress before atomic rename (tokio::fs::rename).
Write installed-awaiting-node-start after rename succeeds.
Signal to supervisor to start node/wallet; after wallet_ready fires, write node-start-verified and emit MithrilStatus completed.

tasks.title: Write mithril.rs — snapshot-converter orchestration
tasks.description: After mithril-client exits successfully and staging is validated, spawn snapshot-converter, wait for exit, emit converting/installing phase events.
implementationNotes: CLI (from TS source): snapshot-converter --input-mem <staging/ledger/<slot>> --output-lsm-snapshot <staging/ledger/<slot>> --output-lsm-database <chain_path>/lsm --config <configFile>
Emit MithrilStatus { phase: 'converting' } before spawn.
Pipe stderr to watchdog logger (same pattern as node/wallet stderr logging).
On non-zero exit: emit MithrilError, clean staging, return Err.
Emit MithrilStatus { phase: 'installing' } after converter exits, before atomic rename.

tasks.title: Wire cancellation in mithril.rs
tasks.description: Implement cancel_mithril command handling: send SIGTERM to the in-flight mithril-client or snapshot-converter process group, clean staging, emit cancelled status.
implementationNotes: Use a tokio::sync::oneshot or watch channel to signal cancellation.
In download and converter loops, select! on the cancel channel.
On cancellation: kill child process (child.kill()), clean staging dir, emit MithrilStatus { phase: 'cancelled' }.
On Windows: use TerminateProcess rather than SIGTERM.

tasks.title: Wire start_mithril / cancel_mithril commands in supervisor.rs
tasks.description: Parse start_mithril and cancel_mithril commands from stdin in the supervisor's command loop. Spawn the Mithril task as a Tokio task and route MithrilEvent to the stdout event sender.
implementationNotes: Add Cmd::StartMithril and Cmd::CancelMithril to the command enum (or match on string).
Spawn tokio::task::spawn for the Mithril lifecycle, passing a cancel_tx sender.
Route MithrilEvent variants to the Event enum and write to stdout (same as existing node events).
After Mithril installing completes, invoke existing node/wallet supervisor startup sequence.
After wallet_ready in the Mithril flow, write node-start-verified marker and emit MithrilStatus completed.
On watchdog startup, check for installed-awaiting-node-start marker and skip directly to node/wallet start.

phases.name: TypeScript Relay Layer
phases.description: Extend CardanoWatchdog.ts types and callbacks, implement IPC channel consolidation, simplify MithrilController and CardanoNode

tasks.title: Extend CardanoWatchdog.ts — types, callbacks, handle methods
tasks.description: Add Mithril fields to WatchdogOptions and WatchdogHandle. Add onMithrilStatus, onMithrilProgress, onMithrilNotNeeded, onMithrilError callbacks to startWatchdog(). Add startMithril() and cancelMithril() methods to WatchdogHandle. Handle new events in readline switch.
implementationNotes: WatchdogOptions: add mithrilBin, aggregatorUrl, genesisVkey, ancillaryVkey (optional), mithrilBehindThreshold (optional, number).
WatchdogHandle: add mithrilPhase: string | null, mithrilProgress: MithrilProgressPayload | null.
Add startMithril(): void — writes {cmd:'start_mithril'} to stdin.
Add cancelMithril(): void — writes {cmd:'cancel_mithril'} to stdin.
Handle mithril_status, mithril_progress, mithril_not_needed, mithril_error in readline switch block.
Pass Mithril config fields into watchdogConfig JSON sent on stdin.

tasks.title: Write mithrilWatchdogChannel.ts — consolidated IPC channels
tasks.description: Create source/main/ipc/mithrilWatchdogChannel.ts with three channels: mithrilEventChannel (push), mithrilStartChannel (trigger), mithrilCancelChannel (trigger). Register handlers in main/index.ts.
implementationNotes: Follow the same pattern as other IPC channels in source/main/ipc/.
mithrilEventChannel: main pushes to renderer; payload is { type: string, payload: object }.
mithrilStartChannel: renderer sends empty trigger; main calls handle.startMithril().
mithrilCancelChannel: renderer sends empty trigger; main calls handle.cancelMithril().
Add channel definitions to source/common/ipc/api.ts.

tasks.title: Simplify MithrilController.ts to event relay
tasks.description: Remove all orchestration, subprocess management, and state machine logic from MithrilController.ts. Keep only the bridge from CardanoNode Mithril callbacks to the mithrilEventChannel push.
implementationNotes: MithrilController becomes a class with onMithrilStatus(), onMithrilProgress(), onMithrilNotNeeded(), onMithrilError() methods that push to mithrilEventChannel.
Remove all references to MithrilPartialSyncService, mithrilCommandRunner, etc.
Remove isPartialSyncNodeStartBlocked() and all state tracking.
Remove startPartialSync(), cancelPartialSync() public methods (these now come from the IPC channels).

tasks.title: Remove Mithril startup coupling from CardanoNode.ts
tasks.description: Remove MithrilPartialSyncNodeStartup wiring, _pendingWatchdogHandle workaround (no longer needed), and Mithril-related callbacks from the node startup flow.
implementationNotes: Remove _pendingWatchdogHandle field and all references — the hang bug is gone because the watchdog handles node/wallet start internally after Mithril.
Remove onHandleCreated callback from startWatchdog() call (or keep if still needed for other reasons).
Remove MithrilPartialSyncNodeStartup import and usage.
Pass MithrilController Mithril event callbacks through to startWatchdog() call.

tasks.title: Remove Mithril guards from handleDiskSpace.ts
tasks.description: Remove mithrilController.isPartialSyncNodeStartBlocked() check and the shouldSuppressStartupFallback() check from the fallback node start path in handleDiskSpace.ts.
implementationNotes: Remove the two Mithril guard checks added during the finalizing-hang fix.
These guards are no longer needed because the watchdog now owns node/wallet start after Mithril.

phases.name: Renderer Store Rewrite
phases.description: Rewrite MithrilPartialSyncStore to subscribe to watchdog push channel; update containers

tasks.title: Rewrite MithrilPartialSyncStore.ts
tasks.description: Replace the polling/status-fetching store with a simple push subscriber. Subscribe to mithrilEventChannel, expose phase, progress, and error state. Implement startMithrilSync() and cancelMithrilSync() actions.
implementationNotes: Remove all polling actions and API call logic.
Subscribe to mithrilEventChannel in setup().
Observable fields: phase (string | null), progress (MithrilProgress | null), error (string | null), isPartialSyncEnabled (boolean — set by config, not watchdog).
startMithrilSync(): send mithrilStartChannel trigger.
cancelMithrilSync(): send mithrilCancelChannel trigger.
Keep any availability check logic that is decided at config time (not runtime watchdog state).

tasks.title: Update SyncingConnectingPage and related containers
tasks.description: Update container props and store action references if MithrilPartialSyncStore interface changed. Verify UI phase states still map correctly to display components.
implementationNotes: Check that all store fields consumed by containers still exist under the same names or update the container.
Verify that onMithrilSync prop still wires correctly to store action.
No UI changes expected; this is a plumbing update only.

phases.name: Cleanup and Verification
phases.description: Delete obsolete TypeScript files, update IPC API, run type checks and clippy, update documentation

tasks.title: Delete obsolete TypeScript Mithril files
tasks.description: Delete the 9+ TypeScript files that are replaced by the Rust implementation.

tasks.title: Run clippy, tsc, and update common/ipc/api.ts
tasks.description: Verify no type errors or dead code. Update source/common/ipc/api.ts to remove old channel definitions and add new ones.
implementationNotes: Run: npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck
Run: nix build .#checks.x86_64-linux.watchdog-clippy
Fix any remaining type errors from deleted files.

tasks.title: Update watchdog.md documentation with Mithril IPC events
tasks.description: Add Mithril events (mithril_status, mithril_progress, mithril_not_needed, mithril_error) and commands (start_mithril, cancel_mithril) to .agent/system/watchdog.md.

riskAreas: snapshot-converter argument format and exit behavior — verify from binary help output before implementing task-007
Windows process group cancellation — SIGTERM semantics differ; may need TerminateProcess in task-008
Staging directory path on Windows — path separator and drive letter handling in task-005
Rate-limiting progress events — too aggressive slows UI; too loose floods IPC; 500 ms is a starting point
Marker file resume on installed-awaiting-node-start — must not re-download if watchdog is restarted mid-session
summary.testingNotes: Manual QA covers the full lifecycle including cancel, not-needed, and resume from marker. No unit tests for Rust Mithril module initially; integration test via actual mithril-client binary.
summary.rollbackPlan: Revert the branch. Old TypeScript files are in git history. Marker file format is unchanged between old and new implementations.
